title: 新加坡进口人、关税与GST
summary_zh: 新加坡海关区分应税商品关税与GST，并说明进口人与发票收货方的关系；许可、豁免及税务安排需按实际运输与商品核查。
summary_en: Singapore Customs distinguishes dutiable goods from other goods generally subject to GST and explains who is the importer. Permit exceptions and tax schemes depend on the transaction.
anchor_terms: local company is considered the importer

cash_effect: Allocate any import tax outflow to the contractual payer; GST is not simply a customs duty.
title_en: Singapore importers, customs duties and GST

新加坡进口人、关税与GST
新加坡海关区分应税商品关税与GST，并说明进口人与发票收货方的关系；许可、豁免及税务安排需按实际运输与商品核查。
Singapore Customs distinguishes dutiable goods from other goods generally subject to GST and explains who is the importer. Permit exceptions and tax schemes depend on the transaction.
